Front: Chamberlain NR-222: What are the exact timeframes for the Transtheoretical Model of Change?
Back: Precontemplation (no intent in 6 mo), Contemplation (intent within 6 mo), Preparation (intent within 30 days), Action (< 6 mo changed), Maintenance (> 6 mo sustained).
